name: Amy I. Chen
office: Foothill Municipal Water District, Member, Board of Directors, Division 4

items.text: Amy Chen is a licensed professional engineer. She worked as an engineer at the Los Angeles Department of Water and Power. She also worked on water policy and rates at the San Diego County Water Authority. Her campaign prioritizes affordable rates and emergency preparedness. She also supports infrastructure investments. She supports sustainable water supplies to provide reliable water.
